issues.problem: Distractor けど is not plainly wrong before a request: prefatory けど (雨が降っているけど、窓を閉めてください) is natural spoken Japanese.
issues.action: Replaced けど with と (と cannot precede a request or volitional clause).

issues.problem: Distractor けど is not plainly wrong before a permission request: prefatory けど (頭が痛いけど、早めに帰ってもいいですか) is acceptable.
Non-focus topic slot after the day word could equally be が inside the ので clause (土曜日が休みなので).
